name: Cyclopean Seer
summary: A cyclopean seer draws power from the mysterious prophetic abilities of ancient giants.
replacesText: Class Skills; Curse; Bonus Spells; 1st and 7th-level Revelations; Final Revelation

features.name: Recommended Mysteries
features.summary: Ancestor ( Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Magic 53), lore, nature, occult ( Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Occult Mysteries 53), time ( Ultimate Magic 56).

features.name: Class Skills
features.summary: A cyclopean seer adds Linguistics and all Knowledge skills to her list of class skills. These replace the additional class skills granted by her mystery.

features.name: Assume Fate (Su)
features.summary: As an immediate action when targeted by an effect that requires a saving throw, you can choose another creature within line of sight that is attempting a save against the same effect. The target takes a penalty on its saving throw equal to 1d4 + 1 for every 4 levels you possess. You gain the value of their penalty as a luck bonus on your saving throw. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Charisma bonus. This replaces the revelation gained at 1st level.

resourceActions.label: Roll Assume Fate

confirmations.label: Another creature I can see is saving against the same effect

appliedEffect.name: Assume Fate
appliedEffect.description: Apply a +{amount} luck bonus to your save against this effect. The other creature takes a penalty of the same size.

resourceActions.summary: Roll the penalty and apply the matching luck bonus to your next saving throw against the effect.

features.name: Brutal Trance (Su)
features.summary: Once per day as a standard action, you can enter a trance that lasts 1 round per oracle level you possess. While in this trance, you are confused, but each round that you can act normally, you can ask a single question as if using commune . This replaces the revelation gained at 7th level.

resourceActions.label: Enter Brutal Trance

activeEffect.name: Brutal Trance
activeEffect.description: You are confused for the duration. When you can act normally, ask one question that round as with commune.

resourceActions.summary: Track confusion and the one-round-per-oracle-level duration.

resourceActions.label: Ask a Brutal Trance question

confirmations.label: I can act normally and have asked no other question this round

resourceActions.summary: Ask one question as commune while the trance is active.

features.name: Doomsaying (Su)
features.summary: Curse a creature within 30 feet. Choose attacks, saving throws, or skill checks. The penalty equals your oracle level and ends on its first failed roll of that kind or after 1 minute.

resourceActions.label: Pronounce Doomsaying

modes.label: Attack rolls
modes.summary: The creature takes a −{classLevel} penalty on attack rolls until it fails one or the curse expires.

modes.label: Saving throws
modes.summary: The creature takes a −{classLevel} penalty on saving throws until it fails one or the curse expires.

modes.label: Skill checks
modes.summary: The creature takes a −{classLevel} penalty on skill checks until it fails one or the curse expires.

confirmations.label: The target is within 30 feet and can be affected by a curse

activeEffect.name: Doomsaying
activeEffect.description: Dismiss this effect when the target fails one of the penalized rolls.

resourceActions.summary: Track the chosen penalty and end it when the condition is met.

features.name: Flash of Insight (Su)
features.summary: Before rolling one of your own dice, choose its exact result as an immediate action. Gain one daily use, or an additional use if you already have the cyclops racial ability.

resourceActions.label: Choose a Flash of Insight result

confirmations.label: This is my own die and I have not rolled it

resourceActions.summary: Declare the result before rolling. At 20th oracle level a d20 result at or below your Charisma modifier costs no daily use.

features.name: Prescience (Ex)
features.summary: Your concentration modifier and AC against attacks of opportunity each increase by 2, then by 1 at oracle levels 5, 10, 15, and 20.

features.name: Final Revelation
features.summary: Upon reaching 20th level, you embody ancient cyclopes’ insight. You can use each of the following once per day as a spell-like ability: discern location , prying eyes , and stone tell . In addition, using flash of insight to select a d20 roll result equal to or lower than your Charisma modifier doesn’t expend that ability. This replaces the final revelation of the oracle’s mystery.

resourceActions.label: Use Discern Location
resourceActions.summary: Use this capstone spell-like ability once per day.

resourceActions.label: Use Prying Eyes
resourceActions.summary: Use this capstone spell-like ability once per day.

resourceActions.label: Use Stone Tell
resourceActions.summary: Use this capstone spell-like ability once per day.

mechanicalNotes: Assume Fate, Doomsaying, Flash of Insight, and Prescience use selectable or tracked mechanics. Apply the other creature’s save penalty, dismiss Doomsaying on its first failed roll, use a declared Flash of Insight result at the table, and adjudicate curse effects and Commune answers separately.

featureOverrides.summary: Choose a mystery for its revelations. Cyclopean Seer supplies its own bonus spells, extra revelation options, class skills, and final revelation.
